QuestInfo.name: Second Material for Building a New House
QuestInfo.1: This time Ronnie wanted #b50 of each of the following: Octopus Legs, Curse Eye Tails, Wild Boar Teeth, and Charms of the Undead#k. These are probably available from the monsters around Deep Forest, the Highlands, and the Ant Tunnels.
QuestInfo.2: You got everything Ronnie needed! He'd better have something amazing waiting for you at the end!

0.0: Oh... Back already? Great! Can you get 50 of each of the following: #b#t4000006#, #t4000013#, #t4000020#, and #t4000008##k? Thanks!

yes.0: Thanks! You may have a travel a bit further to get the materials this time. Let me know when you have them all!

no.0: Are you rejecting my request because I'm young? Hmph!

1.0: Great! You've got everything? Excellent. I'll pass the goods to the fairies. But I think there's still some additional materials they need.

yes.0: There's still a lot of stuff the fairies need. Let me know when you have time to help.

item.0: I don't think you have collected 50 of each of the following yet: #b#t4000006#, #t4000013#, #t4000020#, #t4000008##k. But cheer up! If you help me, I will give something good. I promise.
